exercises.instructionEn: Underline the correct item in bold. (10 marks)
exercises.instructionUz: Qalin harfli to'g'ri variant tagiga chizing. (10 ball)
exercises.explanationUz:
1-4-UNITLAR LUG'ATI TEKShIRUVI.

  ⚠ Har gap ma'lum bir unitdan:
     1  - 1-unit (Tailand matni)
     2  - 2-unit (kosmos matni)
     3  - 2-unit (Liza matni)
     4  - 3-unit (Harrods matni)
     5  - 4-unit (alone/lonely)
     6  - 4-unit (pick up)
     7  - 4-unit (havo shari matni)
     8  - 4-unit (have in mind)
     9  - 1-unit (xarakter sifatlari)
     10 - 1-unit (tashqi qiyofa)


⚠ QIYIN JUFTLIKLAR:

  wills / features
     'a will' = iroda; 'features' = yuz
     tuzilishi.
     'STRONG WILLS' - 7-betdagi matnda.

  crew / audience
     'a crew' = ekipaj; 'an audience' =
     tomoshabinlar.
     13-betdagi 8-mashqda farqi
     tushuntirilgan.

  persuaded / hired
     'to persuade' = ko'ndirmoq;
     'to hire' = yollamoq.
     16-betdagi matnda IKKALASI ham bor.

  employs / spreads
     'to employ' = ishga olmoq;
     'to spread' = yoymoq.
     21-betdagi matnda IKKALASI ham bor.

  alone / lonely
     27-betdagi 7-mashqda farqi
     tushuntirilgan.

  pick / take
     'to pick sb up' = borib olmoq.
     'take' bilan bunday ibora yo'q.

  wailing / blowing
     'the wind BLOWS'; 'a siren WAILS'.
     28-betdagi 14-mashq.

  held / had
     'to HAVE sth in mind' - turg'un
     ibora.

  lazy / mean
     'lazy' = dangasa; 'mean' = xasis.
     'He doesn't like WORKING' - demak
     DANGASA.

  build / complexion
     'build' = gavda; 'a complexion' =
     yuz rangi.
     'a DARK complexion' - 6-betdagi
     1-mashqda.

tasks.prompt: 1  Thai people have strong ___ .
tasks.promptUz: Kuchli nima?
tasks.whyUz:
⚠ 'a will' = iroda.
⚠ 7-betdagi matnda: 'We are a happy people who
have STRONG WILLS'.
⚠ 'features' = yuz tuzilishi - 'strong' bilan
kelmaydi.

tasks.prompt: 2  Mission Control wakes the ___ up at 6:41 pm CST.
tasks.promptUz: Kosmik kemadagi odamlar guruhi qanday ataladi?
tasks.whyUz:
⚠ 'a crew' = ekipaj (kema, samolyot).
⚠ 'an audience' = tomoshabinlar (teatr).
⚠ 13-betdagi 8-mashqda farqi tushuntirilgan.

tasks.prompt: 3  Liza's friends ___ her to send a cassette to a record company.
tasks.promptUz: Do'stlari nima qilishdi?
tasks.whyUz:
⚠ 'to persuade sb TO DO sth' = ko'ndirmoq.
⚠ 'to hire' = yollamoq - bu yerda mos kelmaydi.
⚠ 16-betdagi matnda: 'they PERSUADED me to send
a cassette'.

tasks.prompt: 4  Harrods ___ over 4,000 staff.
tasks.promptUz: Do'kon xodimlarga nima qiladi?
tasks.whyUz:
⚠ 'to employ' = ishga olmoq.
⚠ 'to spread' = yoymoq ('300 departments SPREAD
over seven floors').
⚠ 21-betdagi matnda IKKALASI ham bor - farqni
seziing.

tasks.prompt: 5  Leave me ___ , please.
tasks.promptUz: Meni yolg'iz qoldiring - qaysi so'z?
tasks.whyUz:
⚠ 'alone' = yolg'iz (HOLAT).
⚠ 'lonely' = yolg'izlikdan qiynalgan
(HIS-TUYG'U).
⚠ 27-betdagi 7-mashqda farqi tushuntirilgan.

tasks.prompt: 6  James will ___ me up in his car.
tasks.promptUz: Mashinada borib olish qanday aytiladi?
tasks.whyUz:
⚠ 'to pick sb up' = borib olmoq.
⚠ 'to take sb up' - bunday ibora bu ma'noda
yo'q.
⚠ 30-betdagi hikoyada: 'Bob PICKED her up in
his car'.

tasks.prompt: 7  A gentle breeze was ___ in through the window.
tasks.promptUz: Shamol nima qiladi?
tasks.whyUz:
⚠ 'the wind/breeze BLOWS' = esadi.
⚠ 'to wail' = uvillamoq (SIRENA).
⚠ 28-betdagi 14-mashqda tovush fe'llari.

tasks.prompt: 8  That wasn't what I ___ in mind.
tasks.promptUz: Ko'zda tutgan - qaysi fe'l?
tasks.whyUz:
⚠ 'to HAVE sth in mind' - TURG'UN ibora.
⚠ 'to hold in mind' - bunday ibora yo'q.
⚠ 30-betdagi hikoyada: 'what I HAD IN MIND'.

tasks.prompt: 9  George is very ___ . He doesn't like working.
tasks.promptUz: Ishlashni yoqtirmaydigan odam qanday?
tasks.whyUz:
⚠ "He doesn't like WORKING" - demak DANGASA.
⚠ 'mean' = xasis (pul haqida).
⚠ 8-betdagi 14-mashqda 'mean' tushuntirilgan.

tasks.prompt: 10  He's got a dark ___ .
tasks.promptUz: Yuz rangi qanday ataladi?
tasks.whyUz:
⚠ 'a complexion' = yuz/teri rangi.
⚠ 'build' = gavda tuzilishi ('medium build').
⚠ 6-betdagi 1-mashqda: 'a DARK COMPLEXION'.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the correct word. (10 marks)
exercises.explanationUz:
1-4-UNITLAR LUG'ATIDAN.


⚠ QAYSI SO'Z QAYSI UNITDAN:

  celebrate    - 1-unit (Tailand)
  accounts     - 3-unit (Parij)
  tropical     - 1-unit (Tailand)
  projects     - 2-unit (kosmos)
  destination  - 1-unit (Tailand)
  friendly     - 1-unit (xarakter)
  ancient      - 1-unit (Tailand)
  short        - 2-unit (kosmos)
  anniversary  - 4-unit (hikoya)
  couple       - 2-unit (kosmos)


⚠ GAP MANTIG'IGA QARANG:

  1  'many festivals' → CELEBRATE
     (nishonlamoq)
  2  'big bank ___' → ACCOUNTS
     (bank hisobi)
  3  '___ climate and beautiful beaches'
     → TROPICAL (Fiji - tropik orol)
  4  'astronauts work on ___ involving
     satellites' → PROJECTS
  5  'a popular holiday ___' →
     DESTINATION (ta'til manzili)
  6  '___ people at the party' →
     FRIENDLY (samimiy odamlar)
  7  '___ temples in India' → ANCIENT
     (qadimiy ibodatxonalar)
  8  'a ___ break for lunch' → SHORT
     (qisqa tanaffus)
  9  'my parents' wedding ___ ... They
     got married in 1972' →
     ANNIVERSARY (to'y yilligi)
  10 'sleeps for a ___ of hours' →
     COUPLE (bir-ikki soat)


⚠ 9-BANDGA DIQQAT:

  'They got married in 1972' - bu
  KALIT: agar 1972-yilda uylangan
  bo'lsa, bugun - YILLIK.


⚠ 10-BAND - 'A COUPLE OF':

  ⚠ 'a couple OF hours' - 'of' ShART.
  ⚠ 13-betdagi 6-mashqda ham bor edi.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the gaps with prepositions from the list. (8 marks)
exercises.instructionUz: Bo'shliqlarni ro'yxatdagi predloglar bilan to'ldiring. (8 ball)
exercises.explanationUz:
1-4-UNITLARDAGI PREDLOGLI IBORALAR.


TO'LIQ RO'YXAT:

  1  to call FOR a taxi
     (27-bet, 8-mashq)
  2  to have sth IN common
     (8-bet, 11-mashq)
  3  to consist OF sth
     (8-bet, 11-mashq)
  4  to be proud OF sb
     (8-bet, 11-mashq)
  5  FROM 8 am TILL 4 pm
     (19-bet, 10-mashq)
  6  according TO sb
     (13-bet, 9-mashq)
  7  to wait FOR sb/sth
     (27-bet, 8-mashq)
  8  to take over FOR the night
     (13-bet, 9-mashq)

  ⚠ Hamma ibora ilgari o'rganilgan -
  bu TAKRORLASh mashqi.


⚠ 5-BANDDA IKKI PREDLOG:

  'FROM 8 am TILL 4 pm'
  ⚠ 'from ... till ...' - JUFTLIK:
  biri bo'lsa ikkinchisi ham ShART.


⚠ 'FOR' UCh MARTA IShLATILADI:

  1  call FOR a taxi
  7  wait FOR a taxi
  8  take over FOR the night

  ⚠ Ro'yxatda 'for' bir marta yozilgan,
  lekin uch joyda kerak - ro'yxatdagi
  so'zni QAYTA ishlatish mumkin.


⚠ 'OF' IKKI MARTA:

  3  consists OF
  4  proud OF

exercises.instructionEn: Read the beginning (a) and ending (b) of a story, and put the verbs in brackets into the past simple or past continuous, then answer the questions. (15 marks)
exercises.instructionUz: Hikoyaning boshlanishi (a) va tugashini (b) o'qing, qavsdagi fe'llarni past simple yoki past continuous shakliga qo'ying, so'ng savollarga javob bering. (15 ball)
exercises.explanationUz:
TOM RIDLEY HAQIDAGI HIKOYa.

  ⚠ Bu - 4-unitdagi hikoya yozish
  mavzusining tekshiruvi (29 va
  31-betlar).


⚠ QAYSI ZAMON QAYERDA:

  PAST CONTINUOUS (fon va uzun ish):
     2 was blowing (ob-havo - FON)
     3 was walking (uzun ish)
     8 was coming (davom etayotgan
        tovush)

  PAST SIMPLE (voqealar):
     1 was ('be' - HOLAT fe'li)
     4 heard (qisqa ish)
     5 stopped
     6 looked
     7 realised
     9 arrested
     10 turned
     11 said
     12 handed
     13 looked
     14 smiled
     15 replied


⚠ 3 va 4-BANDLAR - 4-UNIT QOLIPI:

  'Tom WAS WALKING to the newsagent's
   WHEN he HEARD a strange noise.'

  ⚠ UZUN ish + QISQA ish -
  29-betdagi 17-mashqning 'c'
  qo'llanishi.


⚠ 8-BAND - 'WAS COMING':

  'the noise WAS COMING from behind
   the door'
  ⚠ Tovush DAVOM etayotgan edi →
  CONTINUOUS.


⚠ 'A DULL MORNING':

  = xira, quyoshsiz tong.
  ⚠ 'dull' yana 'zerikarli' ma'nosida
  ham bo'ladi.


⚠ 'THE NEWSAGENT'S':

  = gazeta do'koni.
  ⚠ 18-betdagi 1-mashqda o'rganilgan.
  ⚠ EGALIK shakli ('shop' tushirilgan).


⚠ 'TO ARREST':

  = hibsga olmoq.
  ⚠ 'the police' - HAR DOIM KO'PLIK
  ma'nosida: 'the police ARREST'
  ('arrests' XATO).


⚠ 'TO HAND SB STH':

  = uzatmoq.
  ⚠ IKKI to'ldiruvchi, predlogsiz.
  ⚠ 20-betdagi 16-mashqda 'to hand sth
  IN' (topshirmoq) bor edi - BOShQA
  ma'no.


⚠ 'A CHEQUE':

  = chek.
  ⚠ Britaniyada 'a cheque', AQShda
  'a check'.

exercises.explanationUz:
SAKKIZ SAVOL - HIKOYaNING TAHLILI.

  ⚠ Savollar 29-betdagi 'Beginnings -
  Endings' qutisidagi savollar bilan
  AYNI:
     1  where and when
     2  who
     3-5 what happened
     6  what in the end
     7  how felt
     8  a title


⚠ 8-SAVOL - SARLAVHA O'YLAB TOPISh:

  Yaxshi sarlavha:
     • QISQA (3-5 so'z)
     • asosiy fikrni beradi
     • qiziqish uyg'otadi

  Mumkin variantlar:
     'The Strange Noise'
     'A Lucky Sunday'
     'The Museum Robbery'
     'A Reward for Tom'

  ⚠ 23-betdagi Writing qutisida ham
  aytilgan edi: 'We give the article
  an interesting TITLE to attract the
  reader's attention.'


⚠ SAVOLLARDA ZAMONGA DIQQAT:

  'Where and when DOES the story TAKE
   PLACE?' - PRESENT (hikoyani tahlil
   qilyapmiz)
  'What WAS Tom DOING?' - PAST
   CONTINUOUS
  'What HAPPENED?' - PAST SIMPLE
  'How DID Tom FEEL?' - PAST SIMPLE

  ⚠ 29-betdagi 20-mashqda ham shunday
  edi.

exercises.instructionEn: Put the verbs in brackets into the present simple or the present continuous. (10 marks)
exercises.instructionUz: Qavsdagi fe'llarni present simple yoki present continuous shakliga qo'ying. (10 ball)
exercises.explanationUz:
1-UNIT GRAMMATIKASI TEKShIRUVI.


⚠ QOIDA (10-betdan):

  PRESENT SIMPLE:
     odat, doimiy holat, umumiy haqiqat
     belgi so'zlari: always, usually,
        every day

  PRESENT CONTINUOUS:
     hozir bo'layotgan ish, vaqtinchalik
     holat, yaqin kelajakdagi ANIQ reja
     belgi so'zlari: now, at the moment,
        tomorrow, tonight


HAR BANDNING SABABI:

  1  'at the moment' → CONTINUOUS
  2  'tomorrow' - ANIQ reja →
     CONTINUOUS
  3  do'kon DOIMIY sotadi → SIMPLE
  4  'know' - HOLAT fe'li → SIMPLE
  5  'at this time of year' - ShU
     DAVRDA → CONTINUOUS
  6  'this afternoon' - ANIQ reja →
     CONTINUOUS
  7  narx DOIMIY → SIMPLE
  8  hozir yomg'ir yog'yapti →
     CONTINUOUS
  9  'tonight' - ANIQ reja → CONTINUOUS
  10 'every day' → SIMPLE


⚠ 4-BAND - HOLAT FE'LI:

  'Sue KNOWS a lot about computers.'
  ⚠ 'know' - HOLAT fe'li, CONTINUOUS
  shaklda ISHLATILMAYDI.
  ⚠ 'is knowing' - XATO.


⚠ 7-BAND - 'COST':

  'It COSTS a lot of money.'
  ⚠ 'cost' ham HOLAT fe'li.
  ⚠ 'is costing' - XATO.


⚠ 2, 6, 9-BANDLAR - KELAJAK:

  'I AM SEEING Tom tomorrow.'
  'The space shuttle IS TAKING OFF
   this afternoon.'
  'Sharon IS COMING to my house
   tonight.'

  ⚠ Hammasi ANIQ, kelishilgan reja →
  PRESENT CONTINUOUS.


⚠ 3-ShAXS BIRLIKDAGI -S:

  3  sells
  4  knows
  7  costs
  10 drives

  ⚠ -S ni UNUTMANG!


⚠ 'TO TAKE OFF':

  = uchib ketmoq (samolyot, raketa).
  ⚠ Aksi: 'to land' = qo'nmoq
  (30-betdagi hikoyada).

exercises.instructionUz: Qavsdagi fe'llarni past simple yoki past continuous shakliga qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
4-UNIT GRAMMATIKASI TEKShIRUVI.

  ⚠ Bu mashqning davomi keyingi betda
  (33-bet).


⚠ QOIDA (29-betdan):

  PAST SIMPLE:
     tugagan, qisqa ish
  PAST CONTINUOUS:
     uzun ish, fon, uni bo'lgan ish


HAR BANDNING SABABI:

  1  'It was cold ... SO we lit a fire' -
     natija, qisqa ish → SIMPLE
  2  'I MET Ann WHILE I was doing the
     shopping' - uzun ish 'while' bilan
     → CONTINUOUS
  3  'The sun WAS SHINING WHEN John woke
     up' - fon → CONTINUOUS
  4  'He WAS READING a book WHEN the
     lights went out' - uzun ish →
     CONTINUOUS
  5  'They WERE CLEANING the house WHEN
     he called' - uzun ish → CONTINUOUS
  6  'She BROKE the computer WHEN she
     tried to move it' - IKKI qisqa
     ish → SIMPLE


⚠ 6-BAND - ISTISNO:

  'She BROKE the computer when she
   TRIED to move it.'

  ⚠ Bu yerda IKKALA fe'l ham PAST
  SIMPLE, chunki ikkalasi ham QISQA
  va KETMA-KET.

  ⚠ Qolgan bandlarda esa BITTA uzun +
  BITTA qisqa ish bor.


⚠ NOTO'G'RI FE'LLAR:

  light → LIT (yoqmoq)
  break → BROKE (sindirmoq)
  meet  → MET (uchrashmoq)
  shine → SHONE (porlamoq)
  read  → READ (talaffuzi o'zgaradi)
  go    → WENT

  ⚠ 'lit' - 'lighted' ham to'g'ri,
  lekin 'lit' ko'proq ishlatiladi.


⚠ 'THE LIGHTS WENT OUT':

  = chiroq o'chdi.
  ⚠ 'to go out' bu yerda = o'chmoq
  (chiroq, o't).
  ⚠ 8-bandda esa 'to go out' = tashqariga
  chiqmoq edi - IKKI XIL ma'no!

tasks.promptUz: Natija - qisqa ish
tasks.whyUz:
⚠ 'so' - NATIJA bog'lovchisi; qisqa ish →
PAST SIMPLE.
⚠ 'light' - NOTO'G'RI fe'l: light - lit - lit.
tasks.speak: 1  It was cold on Sunday night, so we ___ (light) a fire.

tasks.promptUz: 'while' dan keyin qaysi zamon?
tasks.whyUz:
⚠ 'WHILE' + UZUN ish → PAST CONTINUOUS.
⚠ 'to do the shopping' - 12-betdagi 1a mashqida
ham bor edi.
tasks.speak: 2  I met Ann while I ___ (do) the shopping.

tasks.promptUz: Fon tasviri
tasks.whyUz:
⚠ FON → PAST CONTINUOUS.
⚠ 'when' dan keyin QISQA ish ('woke up').
⚠ 'shine' - NOTO'G'RI fe'l: shine - shone - shone.
tasks.speak: 3  The sun ___ (shine) when John woke up that morning.

tasks.prompt: 4  He ___ (read) a book when the lights went out.
tasks.promptUz: Uzun ish, uni qisqa ish bo'ldi
tasks.whyUz:
⚠ UZUN ish → PAST CONTINUOUS.
⚠ 'the lights WENT OUT' = chiroq o'chdi
(qisqa ish).
⚠ 'read' - o'tgan zamonda /red/ deb o'qiladi.
tasks.speak: 4  He ___ (read) a book when the lights went out.

tasks.prompt: 5  They ___ (clean) the house when he called.
tasks.promptUz: Uzun ish, ega ko'plikda
tasks.whyUz:
⚠ UZUN ish → PAST CONTINUOUS.
⚠ Ega 'They' - KO'PLIK → 'were'.
⚠ 'to call' bu yerda = qo'ng'iroq qilmoq.
tasks.speak: 5  They ___ (clean) the house when he called.

tasks.prompt: 6  She ___ (break) the computer when she tried to move it.
tasks.promptUz: Ikki qisqa ish ketma-ket
tasks.whyUz:
⚠ ISTISNO: IKKALA fe'l ham QISQA va KETMA-KET →
ikkalasi ham PAST SIMPLE.
⚠ 'break' - NOTO'G'RI fe'l: break - broke -
broken.
tasks.speak: 6  She ___ (break) the computer when she tried to move it.

5-MAShQNING DAVOMI (32-betdan).


HAR BANDNING SABABI:

  7  'last night' - TUGAGAN vaqt →
     PAST SIMPLE so'roq: 'DID you
     WATCH ...?'

  8  'last night' → PAST SIMPLE:
     'Steve HELPED me.'

  9  TASVIR (qanday kiyingan edi) →
     PAST CONTINUOUS: 'The man WAS
     WEARING an expensive suit.'
     ⚠ 'and HAD a beard' - 'have' HOLAT
     fe'li, shuning uchun SIMPLE.

  10 'when the doorbell rang' - qisqa
     ish uzun ishni bo'ldi →
     PAST CONTINUOUS: 'She WAS PLAYING
     the piano.'


⚠ 7-BAND - SO'ROQ ShAKLI:

  'DID you WATCH ...?'
  ⚠ 'did' dan keyin fe'l ODDIY shaklda.
  ⚠ 'Did you watched' - XATO.


⚠ 9-BANDDA IKKI ZAMON BIR GAPDA:

  'The man WAS WEARING an expensive
   suit and HAD a beard and moustache.'

  ⚠ 'wear' - harakat → CONTINUOUS
  ⚠ 'have' (egalik) - HOLAT → SIMPLE

  ⚠ Bu - juda muhim farq.


⚠ 10-BAND - 4-UNIT QOLIPI:

  UZUN ish (was playing) + QISQA ish
  (rang) = 17-mashqning 'c'
  qo'llanishi (29-bet).


⚠ 'TO PLAY THE PIANO':

  ⚠ Cholg'u oldidan 'THE' ShART:
  'play THE piano', 'play THE guitar'.
  ⚠ Sport oldidan artikl YO'Q:
  'play football'.

'when' dan keyin QISQA ish ('rang').

exercises.instructionEn: Number the adjectives in the correct order. (5 marks)
exercises.explanationUz:
3-UNIT GRAMMATIKASI TEKShIRUVI
(20-betdagi qoida).


⚠ TARTIB:

  FIKR → O'LChAM → OG'IRLIK → ShAKL →
  RANG → MATERIAL → OT


HAR BANDNING TAHLILI:

  1  small (o'lcham) = 1
     triangular (shakl) = 2
     gold (material) = 3
     → 'small triangular gold earrings'

  2  pretty (fikr) = 1
     pink (rang) = 2
     woollen (material) = 3
     → 'a pretty pink woollen jumper'

  3  expensive (fikr) = 1
     brown (rang) = 2
     leather (material) = 3
     → 'expensive brown leather shoes'

  4  nice (fikr) = 1
     black (rang) = 2
     velvet (material) = 3
     → 'a nice black velvet dress'

  5  small (o'lcham) = 1
     blue (rang) = 2
     plastic (material) = 3
     → 'a small blue plastic bag'


⚠ HAR BANDDA MATERIAL OXIRIDA:

  gold, woollen, leather, velvet,
  plastic - hammasi OTGA ENG YaQIN.

  ⚠ Bu - eng oson eslab qolinadigan
  qoida.


⚠ 1-BANDDA FIKR SIFATI YO'Q:

  'small triangular gold' - uchalasi
  ham FACT sifatlari.
  ⚠ Shuning uchun tartib: o'lcham →
  shakl → material.


⚠ 'EARRINGS':

  = sirg'alar.
  ⚠ 'ear' (quloq) + 'ring' (uzuk).
  ⚠ HAR DOIM KO'PLIKDA (juftlik).


⚠ 'VELVET':

  = baxmal.
  ⚠ 20-betdagi material ro'yxatida ham
  bor edi.

exercises.instructionUz: Gaplarni ro'yxatdagi sifatlarning qiyosiy yoki eng yuqori darajasi bilan to'ldiring. (5 ball)
exercises.explanationUz:
3-UNIT GRAMMATIKASI TEKShIRUVI
(22-betdagi qoida).


⚠ HAR DIALOGDA 'B' AKSINI AYTADI:

  1  A: John is TALLER than Jim.
     B: No, he isn't. He's SHORTER.
     ⚠ 'tall' ning aksi 'short'.

  2  A: This was the CHEAPEST T-shirt.
     B: No, it wasn't. It was THE MOST
        EXPENSIVE!
     ⚠ 'cheap' ning aksi 'expensive';
     ENG YUQORI daraja saqlanadi.

  3  A: The red skirt is the SHORTEST.
     B: You must be joking. It's THE
        LONGEST!
     ⚠ 'short' ning aksi 'long'.

  4  A: Bob is OLDER than you.
     B: Of course he isn't. He's
        YOUNGER!
     ⚠ 'old' ning aksi 'young'.

  5  A: What do you think of Jonson's
        new book?
     B: I thought it was even WORSE
        than his last book!
     ⚠ 'bad' → 'worse' (QOIDASIZ).


⚠ QIYoSIY yoki ENG YUQORI - QAYSI:

  A ning gapidagi ShAKLGA qarang:
     'taller THAN' → qiyosiy → 'shorter'
     'THE cheapest' → eng yuqori →
        'the most expensive'
     'THE shortest' → eng yuqori →
        'the longest'
     'older THAN' → qiyosiy → 'younger'
     — 5-bandda 'even ... THAN' →
        qiyosiy → 'worse'


⚠ 'EVEN' + QIYoSIY DARAJA:

  'even worse' = yanada yomonroq.
  ⚠ 'even' qiyosiy darajani
  KUChAYTIRADI (much, far, a lot kabi).


⚠ 'YOU MUST BE JOKING':

  = hazillashyapsiz shekilli.
  ⚠ 'must' - TAXMIN ma'nosida
  (25-betdagi quti).

exercises.instructionEn: Match the questions (1 - 5) to the replies (a - e). (5 marks)
exercises.explanationUz:
1-4-UNITLARDAGI MULOQOT QOLIPLARI.


⚠ HAR SAVOL QAYSI UNITDAN:

  1  ism so'rash - 11-bet, 30-mashq
     ("I didn't catch your name")
  2  transport - 14-bet, 15-mashq
  3  guvoh ko'rsatuvi - 31-bet,
     26-mashq
  4  gul do'koni - 22-bet, 25-mashq
  5  to'lov usuli - 22-bet, 24-mashq


⚠ QANDAY TOPILADI - KALIT SO'ZLAR:

  1  'your NAME' → c: 'Brian, Brian
     Clarke.' (ISM)
  2  'get to WORK' → d: 'I usually go
     BY TRAIN.' (TRANSPORT)
  3  'WHERE were you' → a: 'I was IN
     THE SHOP.' (JOY)
  4  'what FLOWERS' → e: 'Some
     CARNATIONS ... some ROSES.' (GUL)
  5  'pay by CREDIT CARD' → b: 'I'd
     rather pay CASH.' (TO'LOV)


⚠ "I'D RATHER":

  = ... afzal ko'raman.
  ⚠ To'liq: 'I would rather'.
  ⚠ Keyin ODDIY fe'l ('to' YO'Q):
  "I'd rather PAY cash".


⚠ 'A CARNATION':

  = chinnigul.
  ⚠ 22-betdagi 25-mashqda gul do'koni
  dialogi bor edi.


⚠ 'NEXT DOOR TO':

  = ... ning yonidagi.
  ⚠ 'the shop NEXT DOOR TO the bank' =
  bank yonidagi do'kon.
  ⚠ 31-betdagi 26-mashqda 'a burglary
  NEXT DOOR' bor edi.


⚠ 'TO GET TO WORK':

  = ishga yetib bormoq.
  ⚠ 14-betdagi 15-mashqda 'How do you
  get there?' bor edi.

tasks.right: b  No, thank you. I'd rather pay cash.

exercises.instructionEn: The pictures below show the beginning and ending of a story. Use the prompts to help you write a beginning and ending. (14 marks)
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi rasmlar hikoyaning boshlanishi va tugashini ko'rsatadi. Ko'rsatmalardan foydalanib boshlanish va tugash yozing. (14 ball)
exercises.explanationUz:
IKKI SURAT - IKKI QISM.


1-SURAT (yig'ilish xonasi) KO'RSATMALARI:

  Friday afternoon - Mr Yang - chairman
  of Sunyang Industries - have staff
  meeting - try - save the company -
  anxious - secretary - Miss Wong say -
  "I think I have the solution."


2-SURAT (guldasta) KO'RSATMALARI:

  Mr Yang - walk in - front door -
  smile - carry - bouquet of flowers -
  "You did it! You saved the company!"
  Miss Wong - smile - "That's all right.
  It's all in a day's work."


⚠ KO'RSATMALARNI GAPGA AYLANTIRISh:

  Ko'rsatmalar QISQA - siz ularni
  to'liq gapga aylantirasiz va
  ZAMONNI to'g'ri tanlaysiz.

  ⚠ FON → past continuous
  ⚠ VOQEA → past simple


⚠ 29 va 31-BETDAGI QOIDA:

  BOShLANISh: qachon, qayerda, kim,
     avval nima bo'ldi
  TUGASh: oxir-oqibat nima bo'ldi,
     odamlar qanday his qildi


⚠ 'IT'S ALL IN A DAY'S WORK':

  = bu odatiy ish, arzimaydi.
  ⚠ Turg'un ibora: qilgan ishini
  KAMTARLIK bilan aytish.
  ⚠ "a day's work" - egalik apostrofi.


⚠ 'A SOLUTION':

  = yechim.
  ⚠ 'to solve' = hal qilmoq.


⚠ 'TO SAVE THE COMPANY':

  = kompaniyani qutqarmoq.
  ⚠ 'to save' yana 'tejamoq',
  'saqlamoq' ma'nosida ham bo'ladi.


⚠ 'YOU DID IT!':

  = uddaladingiz!
  ⚠ 'did' TA'KIDLANGAN - muvaffaqiyatni
  tabriklash iborasi.

tasks.en: It was Friday afternoon and Mr Yang, the chairman of Sunyang Industries, was having a staff meeting.
tasks.uz: Juma kuni tushdan keyin edi va Sunyang Industries raisi janob Yang xodimlar bilan yig'ilish o'tkazayotgan edi.
tasks.note:
⚠ FON → PAST CONTINUOUS ('was having').
⚠ 'a chairman' = rais (21-betdagi Harrods
matnida ham bor edi).
⚠ IZOh verguller bilan ajratiladi.

tasks.en: They were trying to save the company and everyone looked anxious. Suddenly, his secretary, Miss Wong, said, "I think I have the solution."
tasks.uz: Ular kompaniyani qutqarishga urinishayotgan edi va hamma xavotirli ko'rinardi. To'satdan uning kotibi Miss Vong: "Menimcha, yechimni topdim", - dedi.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'were trying' - FON; 'said' - VOQEA.
⚠ 'anxious' - 28-betdagi 15-mashqda.
⚠ 'Suddenly' - voqeani boshlash so'zi.

tasks.en: A week later, Mr Yang walked in through the front door. He was smiling and he was carrying a big bouquet of flowers.
tasks.uz: Bir haftadan keyin janob Yang oldingi eshikdan kirib keldi. U jilmayardi va katta guldasta ko'tarib turgan edi.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'walked in' - VOQEA → past simple.
⚠ 'was smiling', 'was carrying' - TASVIR →
past continuous.
⚠ 'the front door' - 27-betdagi 6-mashqda.

tasks.en: "You did it! You saved the company!" he said. Miss Wong smiled and replied, "That's all right. It's all in a day's work." Everyone in the office felt very relieved.
tasks.uz: "Uddaladingiz! Kompaniyani qutqardingiz!" - dedi u. Miss Vong jilmayib javob berdi: "Arzimaydi. Bu oddiy ish". Idoradagi hamma o'zini juda yengil his qildi.
tasks.note:
⚠ TO'G'RI NUTQ - hikoyani jonli qiladi
(31-betdagi Writing qutisi).
⚠ "It's all in a day's work" - kamtarlik iborasi.
⚠ 'relieved' - 28-betdagi 9-mashqda.
